name: Tourist / Short-Stay Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Foreigners need a valid entry visa obtained from the nearest Congolese embassy/consulate before travel (processing reported as not exceeding 15 days), a round-trip or circular ticket, a housing certificate signed by a municipal authority, and a vaccination record. CEMAC (Central African Economic and Monetary Community) nationals reportedly move visa-free, though this dataset did not independently verify that against a treaty text.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an entry visa at a Congolese embassy/consulate with the required supporting documents, or travel on a CEMAC-member passport.

evidence_required.document: Housing certificate signed by a municipal authority

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Republic of Congo / Congo-Brazzaville, ISO CG -- distinct from DR Congo [CD], already covered in this dataset). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-3 sourced (an immigration-consultancy blog and a law-firm legal-advice blog). Republic of Congo's own government domains (interieur.gouv.cg, securite-publique.gouv.cg, economie.gouv.cg) were located via search -- each has a relevant page (e.g. a dedicated 'Titre de Séjour' page on two separate ministry sites) -- but every direct fetch attempt failed in this build: one gave an expired-SSL-certificate error, another a DNS resolution failure, another a connection timeout. This is a genuine, disclosed fetch failure, not a claim that these pages don't exist or are wrong -- but unlike Bolivia/Angola earlier in this session, NO tier-1 government source could be reached at all for this country, a real gap.
